detail.longDescription: What would be people's current suggestions for learning to program in C? Resources and tutorials especially (I already have a few thoughts on projects, but open to ideas for small projects). To get a few questions out of the way: "Why?" Because I want to. "Wouldn't you rather learn X?" Maybe, but that's not what I'm asking today. "Don't waste your time." Rude, and not helpful. # askfedi # programming # C
